g.text: Title: MiniDrone - through-hole plug-in Super Mini / GY-521 carrier

g.desc: Title: MiniDrone - through-hole plug-in Super Mini / GY-521 carrier

g.text: 70 x 70 mm hand-soldered THT prototype / 1S 400mAh / BC337 - fit and current validation pending

g.desc: 70 x 70 mm hand-soldered THT prototype / 1S 400mAh / BC337 - fit and current validation pending

g.text: BC337 prototype / 1S 3.7 V 400 mAh / existing Super Mini + GY-521 plug-in boards

g.desc: BC337 prototype / 1S 3.7 V 400 mAh / existing Super Mini + GY-521 plug-in boards

g.text: AD0 is grounded (0x68). R9/R10 are optional pull-ups. Divider: 4.20 V battery -> 2.10 V at GPIO0.

g.desc: AD0 is grounded (0x68). R9/R10 are optional pull-ups. Divider: 4.20 V battery -> 2.10 V at GPIO0.

g.text: Diode stripe / K goes to battery positive. Put each 100 nF capacitor at the motor terminals.

g.desc: Diode stripe / K goes to battery positive. Put each 100 nF capacitor at the motor terminals.

g.text: DRAFT: 330R base resistors and 1N5819 diodes require motor startup/stall-current verification.

g.desc: DRAFT: 330R base resistors and 1N5819 diodes require motor startup/stall-current verification.

g.text: U1 uses functional pin grouping; pad numbers still match the physical headers.

g.desc: U1 uses functional pin grouping; pad numbers still match the physical headers.

g.text: MINIDRONE | all components connected with visible wires

g.desc: MINIDRONE | all components connected with visible wires

g.text: J2: external regulated 5.0 V boost module, >=0.5 A output across battery range.

g.desc: J2: external regulated 5.0 V boost module, >=0.5 A output across battery range.

g.text: RUN: USB unplugged, JP1 fitted. PROGRAM: battery OFF, JP1 removed, then USB.

g.desc: RUN: USB unplugged, JP1 fitted. PROGRAM: battery OFF, JP1 removed, then USB.

g.text: 01 BATTERY, MAIN SWITCH AND EXTERNAL BOOST CONNECTION

g.desc: 01 BATTERY, MAIN SWITCH AND EXTERNAL BOOST CONNECTION

g.text: Motor positives use the battery rail; logic uses the boost + onboard regulator.

g.desc: Motor positives use the battery rail; logic uses the boost + onboard regulator.

g.text: Dots = joined wires. Crossing wires without a dot are separate. Labels only name already-connected wires.

g.desc: Dots = joined wires. Crossing wires without a dot are separate. Labels only name already-connected wires.

g.text: Module dimensions / connector ratings are provisional. No charger, reverse protection or automatic cutoff.

g.desc: Module dimensions / connector ratings are provisional. No charger, reverse protection or automatic cutoff.
